title: The elders

paragraphs: In [Berakhot 22a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.22a.11) and [Chullin 136b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.136b.11-13), accepted practice follows these three elders: Rabbi Ilai, Rabbi Yoshiyah and Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira.[^1][^2]

notes.text: In Berakhot, Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak names Rabbi Ilai, Rabbi Yoshiyah and Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira in that order.
Chullin gives the same three names across successive passages, with Rabbi Yehudah ben Beteira before Rabbi Yoshiyah.
